entry.title: French court hears opening arguments in Bolloré/Vivendi break-up dispute
entry.summary: (Reuters) -France's highest civil court heard arguments on Tuesday in a legal dispute that could require the billionaire ​Bolloré family to buy out minority shareholders of Vivendi for several billions of euros. Vivendi's lawyer ‌Alain Benabent argued that the appeals court had "exceeded its powers", while Bolloré's lawyer argued that it had wrongly broadened ‌the interpretation of control beyond majority voting rights, urging the Cour de Cassation to adhere to a narrower reading of French corporate law. "The Bolloré group does not control Vivendi" he stated, downplaying the personal influence of Vincent Bolloré.
